profiles.name: High-Volume Loyalists
profiles.description: Frequent repeat buyers with consistent order patterns, moderate price sensitivity, and average return rates.
profiles.strategy: Enroll in VIP retention rewards; provide expedited premium returns as a loyalty perk.

profiles.name: Habitual Returners / Wardrobers
profiles.description: High return frequency, multiple items purchased per session with elevated sizing mismatch risk.
profiles.strategy: Offer interactive size-fit recommendations; encourage virtual try-on and store credit incentives.

profiles.name: Bargain & Promo Seekers
profiles.description: Strong responsiveness to discounts (>30%), coupon affinity, impulsive browsing with higher return velocity.
profiles.strategy: Optimize clearance promotion return policies; reinforce pre-order product specifications.

profiles.name: Low-Engagement Occasionals
profiles.description: Low purchase count, short browsing sessions, low coupon usage, predominantly baseline buying habits.
profiles.strategy: Nurture with personalized category onboarding emails and post-purchase check-ins.

profiles.name: Premium Considered Shoppers
profiles.description: High average order values, extensive browsing duration, high catalog rating scrutiny, lowest return rate.
profiles.strategy: Prioritize white-glove packaging, fast-track dispatch, and premium concierge support.
